summary: Iteration 6 (University super-role + Compare Two Careers). Backend: 23/23 tests pass — university login/RBAC, overview shape, schools CRUD (create + duplicate 400 + delete keeps user accounts), students shape/field/school filters. Frontend: university login lands on /university; dashboard renders 4 stat cards, both bar charts, top-careers list (univ-career-N) and quick actions; nav links present; RBAC works (university /dashboard → /university; parent /compare and /university → /parent); Compare flow (wishlist-compare-btn → /compare → select two → compare-go → /compare/:a/:b) renders compare-left-title + compare-right-title correctly. CRITICAL: School create form crashes React and 422s the API when optional email fields are left blank.

critical.issue: Pydantic model uses Optional[EmailStr] for principal_email/counselor_email. If the client sends empty string ("") — which the frontend does by default — Pydantic v2 rejects with 422. Should either accept empty string as None or convert '' -> None with a validator.

ui_bugs.issue: On API error, calls toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed…'). When backend returns 422 the detail is an array of validation-error OBJECTS, which is then rendered as a React child, throwing 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, ctx})' and showing the red runtime-error overlay. Must coerce detail to string (e.g., typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail) or detail?.[0]?.msg).
Empty-string values for principal_email / counselor_email are POSTed even when user leaves them blank. Should strip empty strings before POST (send undefined/null) so Optional[EmailStr] passes.

integration_issues.flow: University → create school with only name+principal_email
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the two bugs above; no school card appears and app throws runtime error overlay. Acceptance criterion from review request fails.

issues: Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (repeated). Add explicit min-height/min-width on ResponsiveContainer wrapper to avoid warnings and potential empty-state layout jumps.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py SchoolCreateInput, add a validator to convert '' → None for principal_email/counselor_email (or accept plain str and validate manually).

In /app/frontend/src/pages/UniversitySchools.jsx save(): (a) strip empty-string email fields before posting; (b) coerce e.response?.data?.detail to string before passing to toast.error to avoid React crash on 422/objects.
Consider adding min-height to Recharts ResponsiveContainer in UniversityDashboard.jsx to silence width/height=-1 warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend blindly renders backend error detail — always coerce to string.
Empty-string EmailStr trap will affect any future forms; consider a shared helper cleanPayload() that strips '' values.
server.py has grown large; university endpoints could live in a routers/ module.
GET /api/wishlist returns 405 (only /api/wishlist/me exists) — students’ REST expectations differ from other resources. Consider aliasing GET /api/wishlist → /me for consistency.
test_credentials: Used seed accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (university, student, parent, admin, counselor, principal).
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ prefixed school then deleted it via API; ensured student wishlist contains at least 'Software Engineer' + 'Data Scientist' for compare test. Frontend compare invoked ONCE per iteration budget note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend university endpoints are fully green. Focus retest on UniversitySchools.jsx create modal — after main agent fixes empty-string email + toast render, verify: (1) only name+principal_email creates a school card + creds banner, (2) duplicate name shows readable toast (not raw object), (3) no React runtime error overlay. Compare flow uses AI (2 calls) — do NOT retest unless changed. Prior iteration5 report json was missing on disk; only iter5.xml present.
rca of the issue: Frontend POSTs { principal_email: '', counselor_email: '' } → Pydantic v2 EmailStr rejects '' → 422 with detail=[{type,loc,msg,input,ctx}]. save() catch does toast.error(detail). react-hot-toast passes children to React → 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. Fix on either side individually mitigates, but both should be fixed defensively.
